001package edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.controller;
002
003import android.os.Bundle;
004import android.util.Log;
005import android.view.Menu;
006import android.widget.AdapterView;
007import android.widget.AdapterView.OnItemSelectedListener;
008import android.widget.ArrayAdapter;
009import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
010import androidx.annotation.Nullable;
011import androidx.appcompat.widget.PopupMenu;
012import androidx.fragment.app.Fragment;
013import android.view.LayoutInflater;
014import android.view.View;
015import android.view.ViewGroup;
016import androidx.lifecycle.LifecycleOwner;
017import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModelProvider;
018import androidx.navigation.Navigation;
019import dagger.hilt.android.AndroidEntryPoint;
020import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.MapsPinsNavGraphDirections;
021import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.R;
022import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.adapter.PinsAdapter;
023import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.databinding.FragmentPinsBinding;
024import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.entity.Pin;
025import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.entity.Track;
026import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.viewmodel.LocationViewModel;
027import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.viewmodel.PinViewModel;
028import java.util.List;
029
030/**
031 * The PinsFragment class represents a fragment for displaying and managing pins within an Android application.
032 * It is responsible for:
033 * - Displaying a list of pins associated with a selected track.
034 * - Handling user interactions with options to add, edit, or delete pins.
035 * - Managing UI updates and interactions through ViewModels and LiveData.
036 *
037 * This class interacts with {@link PinViewModel} to observe and update relevant data, including tracks and pins.
038 * It uses the Android Jetpack Navigation component to navigate between screens.
039 *
040 * PinsFragment implements the {@link AdapterView.OnItemSelectedListener} interface to respond to track selection changes.
041 */
042@AndroidEntryPoint
043public class PinsFragment extends Fragment implements OnItemSelectedListener {
044
045  private FragmentPinsBinding binding;
046  private PinViewModel pinViewModel;
047  private static final String TAG = PinsFragment.class.getSimpleName();
048  private List<Track> tracks;
049  private Track track;
050
051  @Override
052  public View onCreateView(LayoutInflater inflater, ViewGroup container,
053      Bundle savedInstanceState) {
054    binding = FragmentPinsBinding.inflate(inflater, container, false);
055    binding.newPin.setOnClickListener((v) -> Navigation.findNavController(binding.getRoot())
056        .navigate(MapsPinsNavGraphDirections.editPin()));
057    binding.tracks.setOnItemSelectedListener(this);
058    return binding.getRoot();
059  }
060
061  @Override
062  public void onViewCreated(@NonNull View view, @Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
063    super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState);
064    LifecycleOwner lifecycleOwner = getViewLifecycleOwner();
065    pinViewModel = new ViewModelProvider(requireActivity()).get(PinViewModel.class);
066    pinViewModel
067        .getTracks()
068        .observe(lifecycleOwner, (tracks) -> {
069          this.tracks = tracks;
070          ArrayAdapter<Track> adapter =
071              new ArrayAdapter<>(requireContext(), android.R.layout.simple_list_item_1, tracks);
072          binding.tracks.setAdapter(adapter);
073          selectCurrentTrack();
074        });
075    pinViewModel.getTrack().observe(lifecycleOwner, (track) -> {
076      this.track = track;
077      selectCurrentTrack();
078    });
079    pinViewModel
080        .getPins()
081        .observe(lifecycleOwner, this::handlePins);
082  }
083
084  /**
085   * Updates the selection in the track selection UI component to highlight the current track.
086   * <ul>
087   *   <li>If the current track exists and the list of tracks is not null, the method determines the
088   *       index of the current track in the list.</li>
089   *   <li>It then sets the selection in the UI component bound to the track list to this index.</li>
090   * </ul>
091   */
092  private void selectCurrentTrack() {
093    if (track != null && tracks != null) {
094      int position = tracks.indexOf(track);
095      binding.tracks.setSelection(position);
096    }
097  }
098
099  /**
100   * Handles the display and management of a list of pins. Sets up the PinsAdapter for the RecyclerView,
101   * providing a way to handle long-click interactions on individual pins.
102   *
103   * @param pins A list of {@link Pin} objects to be displayed and managed.
104   */
105  private void handlePins(List<Pin> pins) {
106    PinsAdapter adapter;
107    adapter = new PinsAdapter(requireContext(), pins, (v, pin, position) -> {
108
109      PopupMenu popup = new PopupMenu(requireContext(), v);
110      Menu menu = popup.getMenu();
111      popup.getMenuInflater().inflate(R.menu.pin_options, menu);
112      menu.findItem(R.id.edit_pin).setOnMenuItemClickListener(item -> {
113        Log.d(TAG, String.format("onMenuItemClick: item=%s", item));
114        Navigation.findNavController(binding.getRoot())
115            .navigate(MapsPinsNavGraphDirections.editPin().setPinId(pin.getId()));
116        return true;
117      });
118      menu
119          .findItem(R.id.delete_pin)
120          .setOnMenuItemClickListener((item) -> {
121            Log.d(TAG, String.format("onMenuItemClick: item=%s", item));
122            pinViewModel.delete(pin);
123//            adapter.notifyItemRemoved(position);
124            return true;
125          });
126      popup.show();
127      return true;
128    });
129    binding.pins.setAdapter(adapter);
130  }
131
132  @Override
133  public void onItemSelected(AdapterView<?> adapterView, View view, int position, long generatedId) {
134    pinViewModel.setTrack((Track) adapterView.getItemAtPosition(position));
135  }
136
137  @Override
138  public void onNothingSelected(AdapterView<?> adapterView) {
139//No action needed, this doesn't happen
140  }
141}
